quiz.question: You clicked a suspicious link at work. Best first move?
options: Wait and see if anything happens
Report it to IT right away
Delete the email and forget it
quiz.answer_text: Report it to IT right away
quiz.why: Reporting fast lets IT contain the problem, and nobody gets in trouble for reporting.
